title: TinyZKP Agent Receipt Envelope
description: A recommended envelope for returning TinyZKP receipts from AI agent actions and tool calls.

agent_result.description: The agent's human-readable or machine-readable action result.

action.description: A short label for the state-changing action or workflow step.

tool_call_id.description: Optional upstream tool-call identifier from the agent runtime.

policy.description: Optional policy metadata describing why a receipt was required.
